notes: All 74 logical rows are covered contiguously.
No JPN control tokens are present in this file.
Rows 0-36 are skill names; rows 37-73 are their corresponding effect descriptions in the same skill order.
JPN is the semantic authority. Auxiliary wording was used only when it matched JPN mechanics and terminology.
`大和魂` and `愛国者` are distinct JPN skills and remain distinct in Chinese; auxiliary `日本爱国者` was not forced onto `大和魂`.
JPN `工作員` overrides shifted/incorrect auxiliary `Engineering` and is localized as `特工`.
Mother Base terminology follows the current sol-translation convention rather than introducing a second `母基地` naming scheme.
No formal translation CSV, manifest, DAT/KEY or build output was modified.
